fieldCoverageSource: idf-wifi-api-inventory.json: variants[target/profile].symbols[symbol].fields; typedef references are followed through the same variant inventory. Offsets/ABI layout are not computed.
scope: Target contract coverage tracking; task defaults resolve each symbol disposition, implementation, contract, ownership, completion and validation. No completed implementation is inferred from C usage.

W-01.completionContract: Each lifecycle stage publishes native state; cleanup retries the unfinished suffix.
W-01.ownershipContract: The sole Radio registry and serialized mutation lane own the driver.

W-02.completionContract: Future/native terminal state is independent of watch queue capacity.
W-02.ownershipContract: Wi-Fi operation owns result buffers; the event broker owns internal completion.

W-03.completionContract: Detach admission and drain entered callbacks before releasing control storage.
W-03.ownershipContract: Promiscuous broker owns SDK callbacks; subscriptions retain bounded pools.

W-04A.completionContract: Cookie-free completion stays quarantined after public timeout until a proven barrier.
W-04A.ownershipContract: One in-flight raw TX broker owns input and callback snapshots.

W-05.completionContract: Copy only proven-readable callback data; retained storage outlives operation close.
W-05.ownershipContract: CSI capture session and retained Frame/Batch/View/Source owners share a bounded pool.

W-07.completionContract: Typed synchronous getters or explicit Future terminal state; preserve failed restore ownership.
W-07.ownershipContract: Driver setters use the shared Radio lane and validate all live owners.

W-08.completionContract: Per-module cancel and native termination barrier remains contract-pending.
W-08.ownershipContract: Per-module field/state/secret/owner contract must be completed before registration.

W-09.completionContract: Keep explicit recovery and input retention; never restart an unrelated Radio owner.
W-09.ownershipContract: Existing ESP-NOW owners retain queues and share the Radio boundary.
